Micargi 26" RD-7 Road Bike Shimano 7 Speed Lightweight Frame for City Outdoor Bicycle
【SAFER RIDING】Micargi USA Designed RD-7 bike for adults that it is one of the most popular high-rider bikes of Micargi’s RD series, has a classy, sleek look. It allows you to travel at multiple speeds with Shimano 7-speed gear and with Innova 700x23C high quality tires. This high-performing aggressive bike is available in 3 sizes and a range of colors to suit all riders.
【7-SPEED EASIER RIDING】SHIMANO 7 speed front and rear derailleur alloy silver brake for leisure rides to long distance commutes.
【ALLOY CAGE PEDALS】The anti-slip pedals have toothed edges that form a cage to anchor rider’s shoes. This makes pedaling extremely convenient and safe, even in wet conditions.
【ALLOY BRAKE LEVERS】The 2.5-Finger Alloy brakes are lightweight, easy to install, and durable, hence they are fit for every high-speed bike. It is smooth enough to offer you comfortable rides.
【RACING BIKE TIRES】The bike uses Innova 700X23C bike tires, making it perfect for speed riding.
